effective_shot_parameters.note: Both dispatchers can read the same parameters. Callback-only non-use is not global non-use. Names/semantics tied to this game image; original editor presets are separate Shot IDs.

shared_falloff.formula: For selected bounded positive inputs: dist2Q12=(dx*dx>>12)+(dy*dy>>12); require dist2Q12 < (R*4096)^2>>12; d=isqrt(dist2Q12*4096); work=trunc0((R*4096-d)*work/(R*4096)); requestHP(-work,owner16,0).
shared_falloff.traversal: Ascending y then x; within cell follow WORD+0C next tag through registry6EE540. Cell scan inclusive and clipped to map before strict radial test.
shared_falloff.reset: Shared across all processed cells/targets during one dispatch; next call rereads original instance Data1.
shared_falloff.filtered_targets: Friendly/invulnerable Creature fixtures do not attenuate the accumulator; strict radius boundary and outside circle are skipped.
shared_falloff.Boulder74: Quarter-damage candidate is tested for zero, then discarded by distance calculation. Damage80 yields80/70; Damage3 skips both prepared Boulders. Not a category-resistance formula.
shared_falloff.defect: Real order-dependent damage in original machine code; no claim about intended design or every patch.dll hook.

time_mode.shape: Filled half-open square; ascending x then y.

ring_mode.shape: Filled half-open expanding square; ascending x then y. No inner hole or radial-distance condition.
ring_mode.verified: Initial HP32 produces extent0. HP16/Data2=16384 produces extent2 and hits centre plus corner outside equal-radius circle. Plain Data2=2 shifts to0.
